captions.detailed: A compact training floor pump featuring a low, rectangular black base with an integrated circular gauge housing and a small red pressure-release button. A stout black pump barrel rises vertically from the base, housing a light gray sliding piston rod topped with a T-shaped handle that includes black grips. The T-handle moves linearly up and down the barrel axis, while the red button acts as a separate push control next to the gauge.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact training floor pump assembly with a low rectangular base, a vertical black barrel, a sliding T-handle with grips, and an integrated circular gauge housing featuring a small red pressure-release button. Ensure the handle slides prismatically along the barrel axis, and the red button acts as a separate prismatic push control.
captions.factory: Construct a rectangular base plate and integrate a vertical cylinder for the pump barrel, alongside a flat circular cylinder for the gauge housing. Create the plunger assembly using a thin vertical cylinder for the rod, a horizontal cylinder for the T-handle bar, and two outer cylinders for the grips, connecting this assembly via a prismatic joint to the barrel. Finally, model the pressure-release button as a small red box, and attach it to the base using a prismatic joint next to the gauge housing.
